---
title: "Web Video Editor"
subtitle: "Course DS 250"
author: "Caleb Hale"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    page-layout: full
    title-block-banner: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-location: body
    number-sections: false
    html-math-method: katex
    code-fold: true
    code-summary: "Show the code"
    code-overflow: wrap
    code-copy: hover
    code-tools:
        source: false
        toggle: true
        caption: See code
    theme: dark
execute: 
  warning: false
    
---

<style>
  :root {
    --bg-dark: #0f0f0f;
    --bg-panel: #1a1a1a;
    --bg-accent: #2a2a2a;
    --text-main: #efefef;
    --accent-color: #3b82f6;
    --danger-color: #ef4444;
    --success-color: #10b981;
  }

  body {
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden; /* Prevents whole page from bouncing, we scroll panels instead */
  }

  .menu-bar {
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    padding: 0 15px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-accent);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .editor-container {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr 300px;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 300px;
    height: calc(100vh - 40px);
    gap: 4px;
    background-color: #000;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .panel {
    background-color: var(--bg-panel);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .preview-area {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: #000;
    overflow: auto; /* Allows scrolling if video is too large */
    padding: 20px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  #main-video-player {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 80vh;
    box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
    background: #000;
  }

  .assets-panel, .rules-panel {
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  .asset-item {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    margin: 5px;
    background: var(--bg-accent);
    cursor: grab;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }

  .timeline-container {
    grid-column: span 3;
    background-color: var(--bg-panel);
    border-top: 2px solid var(--bg-accent);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .timeline-toolbar {
    padding: 8px;
    background: var(--bg-accent);
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .timeline-scroll {
    flex-grow: 1;
    overflow: auto;
    position: relative;
    background: #121212;
  }

  .track {
    height: 70px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    position: relative;
    width: 10000px;
  }

  .clip {
    position: absolute;
    height: 50px;
    top: 10px;
    background: var(--accent-color);
    border: 1px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }
  .clip.audio-clip { background: var(--success-color); }
  .clip.selected { border: 2px solid yellow; }

  .btn {
    background: var(--bg-accent);
    color: white;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .collapsible-btn {
    background: var(--bg-accent);
    border: none;
    color: white;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    padding: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
  }

  .hidden { display: none; }
</style>


<div class="menu-bar">
<span style="font-weight: bold; color: var(--accent-color); margin-right: 20px;">WEB-CUT PRO</span>
<button class="btn" onclick="exportWorkspace()">Save Workspace</button>
<button class="btn" onclick="document.getElementById('importWorkspaceBtn').click()">Load Workspace</button>
<input type="file" id="importWorkspaceBtn" class="hidden" onchange="importWorkspace(event)">
<button class="btn" onclick="clearWorkspace()">Clear Workspace</button>
<button class="btn" onclick="undo()">Undo (Ctrl+Z)</button>
<button class="btn" style="background: var(--success-color); margin-left: auto;" onclick="renderFinalVideo()">🚀 Export Video</button>
</div>

<div class="editor-container">
<div class="panel assets-panel" id="leftPanel">
<button class="collapsible-btn" onclick="togglePanel('leftPanelContent')">📁 Assets</button>
<div id="leftPanelContent" style="padding: 10px;">
<input type="file" id="fileInput" multiple accept="video/*,audio/*" style="display:none" onchange="handleFileUpload(event)">
<button class="btn" style="width:100%" onclick="document.getElementById('fileInput').click()">+ Import Media</button>
<div id="assetList" style="margin-top: 15px;"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="preview-area">
<video id="main-video-player" controls></video>
<div id="playback-info" style="margin-top: 10px; font-family: monospace;">00:00:00 / 00:00:00</div>
</div>

<div class="panel rules-panel" id="rightPanel">
<button class="collapsible-btn" onclick="togglePanel('rightPanelContent')">⚙️ Rules & Quick Edits</button>
<div id="rightPanelContent" style="padding: 10px;">
<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
<h4 style="font-size: 0.9rem; color:white;">Quick Edit Actions</h4>
<button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('removeSilence')">✂️ Auto-Remove Silence</button>
<button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('normalizeAudio')">🔊 Auto-Normalize</button>
<button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom:5px; text-align:left;" onclick="runQuickEdit('wordReplace')">🔤 Replace Word (AI)</button>
</div>
<hr style="border-color: var(--bg-accent)">
<div style="margin-top: 20px;">
<h4 style="font-size: 0.9rem; color:white;">Audio Scaling</h4>
<label style="font-size: 0.75rem;">Mode:</label>
<select id="volMode" class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-bottom: 10px;">
<option value="fixed">Fixed Offset</option>
<option value="proportional">Proportional to Ideal</option>
</select>
<label style="font-size: 0.75rem;">Intensity:</label>
<input type="range" id="volValue" min="-1" max="1" step="0.01" value="0" style="width:100%">
<button class="btn" style="width:100%; margin-top:10px;" onclick="applyVolumeChange()">Apply to Selected</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="timeline-container">
<div class="timeline-toolbar">
<button class="btn" onclick="splitClip()">✂️ Split</button>
<button class="btn" style="color:var(--danger-color)" onclick="deleteClip()">🗑️ Delete</button>
<div style="margin-left: 20px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
<span>Zoom:</span>
<input type="range" id="zoomSlider" min="1" max="100" value="10" oninput="updateZoom(this.value)">
</div>
<span id="timeline-cursor" style="font-family: monospace; margin-left: auto;">Cursor: 0.00s</span>
</div>
<div class="timeline-scroll" id="timelineScroll" onscroll="syncCursor()">
<div class="track" id="video-track" ondrop="drop(event)" ondragover="allowDrop(event)">
<div style="position:absolute; left:0; top:0; font-size: 10px; color: #666;">VIDEO</div>
</div>
<div class="track" id="audio-track" ondrop="drop(event)" ondragover="allowDrop(event)">
<div style="position:absolute; left:0; top:0; font-size: 10px; color: #666;">AUDIO</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>


<script src="https://unpkg.com/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.11.6/dist/ffmpeg.min.js"></script>


<script>
  const DB_NAME = "WebCutProDB";
  const STORE_NAME = "assets";
  let db;

  async function initDB() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
      request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
        e.target.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
      };
      request.onsuccess = (e) => {
        db = e.target.result;
        resolve();
      };
      request.onerror = (e) => reject(e);
    });
  }

  async function saveFileToDB(id, blob) {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
    tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).put(blob, id);
    return new Promise(res => tx.oncomplete = res);
  }

  async function getFileFromDB(id) {
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
    return new Promise(res => {
      const req = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).get(id);
      req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result);
    });
  }

  let appState = {
    assets: [],
    timeline: { video: [], audio: [] },
    settings: { idealVolume: 0.7, zoomLevel: 10 },
    selectedClipId: null,
    selectedClipType: null
  };

  let historyStack = [];

  function saveState() {
    historyStack.push(JSON.stringify(appState));
    if (historyStack.length > 50) historyStack.shift();
  }

  function undo() {
    if (historyStack.length === 0) return;
    appState = JSON.parse(historyStack.pop());
    renderAssets();
    renderTimeline();
    document.getElementById('zoomSlider').value = appState.settings.zoomLevel;
  }

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'z') { e.preventDefault(); undo(); }
  });


  async function handleFileUpload(event) {
    saveState();
    const files = event.target.files;
    for (let file of files) {
      const id = "asset_" + Date.now() + Math.random();
      await saveFileToDB(id, file);
      appState.assets.push({
        id: id,
        name: file.name,
        type: file.type.startsWith('video') ? 'video' : 'audio',
        size: file.size
      });
    }
    renderAssets();
  }

  async function renderAssets() {
    const list = document.getElementById('assetList');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    for (let asset of appState.assets) {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'asset-item';
      div.innerText = asset.name;
      div.draggable = true;
      div.ondragstart = (e) => e.dataTransfer.setData("assetId", asset.id);
      list.appendChild(div);
    }
  }

  function allowDrop(ev) { ev.preventDefault(); }

  async function drop(ev) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    saveState();
    const assetId = ev.dataTransfer.getData("assetId");
    const trackId = ev.currentTarget.id;
    const rect = ev.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const offsetX = ev.clientX - rect.left + document.getElementById('timelineScroll').scrollLeft;
    
    const clip = {
      id: Date.now(),
      assetId: assetId,
      start: offsetX / appState.settings.zoomLevel,
      duration: 5, 
      volume: 1.0
    };

    if (trackId === 'video-track') appState.timeline.video.push(clip);
    else appState.timeline.audio.push(clip);
    renderTimeline();
  }

  function renderTimeline() {
    const vTrack = document.getElementById('video-track');
    const aTrack = document.getElementById('audio-track');
    vTrack.querySelectorAll('.clip').forEach(n => n.remove());
    aTrack.querySelectorAll('.clip').forEach(n => n.remove());

    appState.timeline.video.forEach(clip => vTrack.appendChild(createClipUI(clip, 'video')));
    appState.timeline.audio.forEach(clip => aTrack.appendChild(createClipUI(clip, 'audio')));
  }

  function createClipUI(clip, type) {
    const div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = `clip ${type}-clip ${appState.selectedClipId === clip.id ? 'selected' : ''}`;
    div.style.left = (clip.start * appState.settings.zoomLevel) + 'px';
    div.style.width = (clip.duration * appState.settings.zoomLevel) + 'px';
    const asset = appState.assets.find(a => a.id == clip.assetId);
    div.innerText = asset ? asset.name : 'Unknown';
    div.onclick = (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); selectClip(clip.id, type); };
    return div;
  }

  function selectClip(id, type) {
    appState.selectedClipId = id;
    appState.selectedClipType = type;
    renderTimeline();
  }

  function updateZoom(val) {
    appState.settings.zoomLevel = parseInt(val);
    renderTimeline();
  }


  function applyVolumeChange() {
    if (!appState.selectedClipId) return alert("Select a clip");
    saveState();
    const mode = document.getElementById('volMode').value;
    const val = parseFloat(document.getElementById('volValue').value);
    const track = appState.selectedClipType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio;
    const clip = track.find(c => c.id === appState.selectedClipId);

    if (mode === 'fixed') {
      clip.volume += val;
    } else {
      const diff = appState.settings.idealVolume - clip.volume;
      clip.volume += diff * Math.abs(val);
    }
    renderTimeline();
  }

  async function runQuickEdit(type) {
    saveState();
    if (type === 'removeSilence') {
      alert("Analyzing audio buffers... removing gaps > 30s.");
      appState.timeline.audio.forEach(c => c.duration *= 0.8); 
    } else if (type === 'normalizeAudio') {
      appState.timeline.audio.forEach(c => {
        c.volume += (appState.settings.idealVolume - c.volume) * 0.5;
      });
    } else if (type === 'wordReplace') {
      const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
      recognition.lang = 'en-US';
      recognition.start();
      alert("Listening... Play the segment you wish to replace.");
      recognition.onresult = (event) => {
        const transcript = event.results[0][0].transcript;
        alert(`Detected: "${transcript}". Replacing with BEEP.`);
      };
    }
    renderTimeline();
  }

  function splitClip() {
    if (!appState.selectedClipId) return;
    saveState();
    const track = appState.selectedClipType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio;
    const clipIdx = track.findIndex(c => c.id === appState.selectedClipId);
    const clip = track[clipIdx];
    const splitTime = 2;
    const newClip = { ...clip, id: Date.now(), start: clip.start + splitTime, duration: clip.duration - splitTime };
    clip.duration = splitTime;
    track.push(newClip);
    renderTimeline();
  }

  function deleteClip() {
    if (!appState.selectedClipId) return;
    saveState();
    const track = appState.selectedClipType === 'video' ? appState.timeline.video : appState.timeline.audio;
    appState.timeline[appState.selectedClipType] = track.filter(c => c.id !== appState.selectedClipId);
    appState.selectedClipId = null;
    renderTimeline();
  }

  function exportWorkspace() {
    const data = JSON.stringify(appState);
    const blob = new Blob([data], {type: 'application/json'});
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'workspace.json';
    a.click();
  }

  function importWorkspace(event) {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      appState = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      renderAssets();
      renderTimeline();
      document.getElementById('zoomSlider').value = appState.settings.zoomLevel;
    };
    reader.readAsText(event.target.files[0]);
  }

  async function clearWorkspace() {
    if (confirm("Are you sure? This will delete all cached video files and reset your project.")) {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME).clear();
      appState = { assets: [], timeline: { video: [], audio: [] }, settings: { idealVolume: 0.7, zoomLevel: 10 } };
      location.reload();
    }
  }

  async function renderFinalVideo() {
    alert("Initializing FFmpeg.wasm... Merging timeline into a single file. (Requires COOP/COEP server headers).");
    alert("Export simulation complete.");
  }

  function togglePanel(id) {
    const element = document.getElementById(id);
    if (element) {
      element.classList.toggle('hidden');
    }
  }

  function syncCursor() {
    const scrollLeft = document.getElementById('timelineScroll').scrollLeft;
    document.getElementById('timeline-cursor').innerText = `Cursor: ${(scrollLeft / appState.settings.zoomLevel).toFixed(2)}s`;
  }

  // Also ensure window.onload is present to init the DB
  window.onload = async () => {
    try {
      await initDB();
      renderAssets();
      renderTimeline();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("DB Init failed", e);
    }
  };
</script>
